findings.highlight: She might be feeling down because I made her wait, but I still have a chance to cheer her up.
findings.evidenceJa: 寒い思いをさせてしまったなら、今からでも温かくなってもらう
findings.governingReading: He made Illya wait in the cold and now proposes warmth, concretized by hot tea.
findings.explanation: Physical cold and warming up become feeling down and cheering up.

findings.highlight: more than entering a lion's den
findings.evidenceJa: 獅子身中の虫どころの話ではない
findings.governingReading: 獅子身中の虫 depicts a destructive element introduced inside one’s own stronghold.
findings.explanation: The enemy within the lion becomes entering a lion’s den.

findings.evidenceJa: 貴方は自ら毒薬を飲もうとしている
findings.governingReading: She says Shirou is drinking poison himself.
findings.explanation: Of is duplicated in Saber’s warning.

findings.highlight: I can promise that Illya won't do anything.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは何もしないって約束した
findings.governingReading: Shirou reports that Illya herself promised to do nothing.

findings.evidenceJa: そこまで目くじらたてる
findings.governingReading: 目くじらを立てる refers to making a fuss or becoming angry over the invitation.
findings.explanation: Saber’s angry opposition becomes nitpicking Illya.

findings.governingReading: それじゃ芸がない refers to no novelty or ingenuity in repeating what she has at her castle.
findings.explanation: Black tea being unimaginative becomes Shirou lacking skill in making it.

findings.highlight: I hold out a second cup of hot water.
findings.governingReading: He hands her the teacup of the green tea just introduced.
findings.explanation: An offered teacup becomes a second cup of hot water.

findings.highlight: that we always have with tea.
findings.evidenceJa: 微妙に好評のようだし、こっちもいつも通り付き合おう
findings.governingReading: The sweets seem moderately well received, so he will go on accompanying her normally.
findings.explanation: Illya’s qualified approval and Shirou keeping her company become a customary serving of well-regarded sweets.

findings.governingReading: Illya calls the house surprisingly cramped or small.
findings.explanation: Smaller than expected becomes more spacious than expected.

findings.highlight: She came here with only vengeance and murder on her mind, and missed her chance to achieve closure.
findings.evidenceJa: 復讐という殺意でしかぶつかれなかった
findings.governingReading: She could reach or collide with the hated person only through murderous revenge, and even that opportunity is gone.
findings.explanation: Revenge as her only possible way to confront Kiritsugu becomes revenge as her only thought and an explicit desire for closure.
